pages.text: The priority key changes a drawer's priority to one of 5 levels. In order from lowest to highest they are: -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, represented by blue or red arrows.$(p)In controller networks, blocks that have the same priority by normal network rules are further distinguished by their priority level.
While holding a priority key, press or hold $(k:sneak) + $(k:use) to cycle between all priority levels
